title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP Programme in Borena, South Omo, Addis Ababa and Tigray, implemented by Trócaire aims to contribute to Outcome 2.1: Poor and marginalised people, especially women and youth, have sustainable lives including diverse food sources and economic well-being. The activities and objective includes support self-help groups (SHG) members on savings and credit skills, Conduct participatory livelihood option and value chain assessment, provide certified trainer-of-trainer on business to local resources, link SHG to market chains and establish new market price information platforms. So people living in poverty, particularly rural women and youth, experience sustainable economic well-being and have control over resources. Programmes are in partnership with Sodo Catholic Secretariat, Organization for Women in Self Employment (WISE) and Association of Pastoralist community for change. ---- The principal focus of this outcome is:- The sustainable economic well-being of people, especially women and youth, via market systems development initiatives- Where possible, income generating initiatives will include an agroecology lensCapacity strengthening of communities is a core element of the approach
